recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The remaining core source mismatches were narrow and implementer-visible; no further core source work was found for this issue beyond normal generated artifact regeneration by the FHIR build.
issue_request: FHIR-27138 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked for SubscriptionTopic search support across a topic's canonical URL and topics derived from it; the accepted resolution removed SubscriptionTopic.derivedFromUri and added derivedOrSelf as a Reference search over url+version or derivedFrom.
initial_application: Historical FHIR-27138 commits 2a4fd55f5a and d77cdf263a removed SubscriptionTopic.derivedFromUri, renamed derivedFromCanonical to derivedFrom, and added the derived-or-self search parameter. Current source retained the search parameter and removed the URI element, but the search parameter was still typed uri and URL guidance still named the removed derivedFromCanonical element.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes SubscriptionTopic and marks it approved, so the SubscriptionTopic StructureDefinition and search-parameter bundle are current build inputs. The 2020 FHIR-I minutes confirm the Jira decision. Later search-parameter naming work found during the investigation did not reverse the FHIR-27138 type or expression decision.

Updated source/subscriptiontopic/structuredefinition-SubscriptionTopic.xml so the SubscriptionTopic.url comment refers to derivedFrom instead of derivedFromCanonical.
